{
  "candidate_rtl": "`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 64 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 6 && W == 64) begin : fast64
        wire [7:0] group_valid;
        wire [7:0] group_enable;
        wire [7:0] group_winner;
        wire [7:0] selected_code [2:0];

        genvar g, b, k;
        for (g = 0; g < 8; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            wire [7:0] x;
            wire [7:0] local_winner;
            wire [2:0] local_code;

            assign x = input_unencoded[8*g +: 8];
            assign group_valid[g] = |x;
            if (g == 7) begin : highest_group
                assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
            end else begin : other_group
                assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[7:g+1]);
            end
            assign group_winner[g] = group_valid[g] & group_enable[g];

            for (b = 0; b < 8; b = b + 1) begin : bits_in_group
                if (b == 7) begin : highest_bit
                    assign local_winner[b] = x[b];
                end else begin : other_bit
                    assign local_winner[b] = x[b] & ~(|x[7:b+1]);
                end

                if (g == 0 && b == 0) begin : default_bit
                    assign output_unencoded[0] = group_enable[0] & ~(|x[7:1]);
                end else begin : ordinary_bit
                    assign output_unencoded[8*g+b] = group_enable[g] & local_winner[b];
                end
            end

            assign local_code[0] = |(local_winner & 8'haa);
            assign local_code[1] = |(local_winner & 8'hcc);
            assign local_code[2] = |(local_winner & 8'hf0);
            for (k = 0; k < 3; k = k + 1) begin : code_terms
                assign selected_code[k][g] = group_enable[g] & local_code[k];
            end
        end

        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
        assign output_encoded[0] = |selected_code[0];
        assign output_encoded[1] = |selected_code[1];
        assign output_encoded[2] = |selected_code[2];
        assign output_encoded[3] = |(group_winner & 8'haa);
        assign output_encoded[4] = |(group_winner & 8'hcc);
        assign output_encoded[5] = |(group_winner & 8'hf0);
    end else begin : general_encoder
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded;
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];

        assign input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};

        genvar l, n;
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : input_pairs
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_pair
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb_pair
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end

        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_merge
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb_merge
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end

        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate

endmodule

`default_nettype wire
",
  "bottleneck": "The reference sends encoded data through repeated priority-selection multiplexers and then decodes that result with a variable shift to produce output_unencoded. This serial encode-then-decode dependency can dominate maximum data arrival.",
  "rewrite": "Specialize the requested configuration into eight parallel eight-bit priority groups. Compute local winners and local codes independently of higher-group suppression. Reduce group-valid signals to select the winning group, form encoded outputs with masked reductions, and generate one-hot outputs directly rather than decoding output_encoded. Retain the original parameterized algorithm for other configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The direct one-hot path removes the encoded-output-to-variable-shift dependency, while grouped encoding replaces the serial selection chain with parallel local encoding and group suppression. A reduction in maximum arrival is expected, but no numerical improvement is claimed without the specified mapped STA run.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Additional parallel local-winner and group-suppression logic trades some logic duplication and fanout for shorter paths; eliminating the variable decoder offsets part of that cost. The 1713.518400um2 area cap and electrical limits require confirmation with the fixed SKY130HD mapping flow; no mapped measurements are available here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For the specified configuration, the highest asserted input index wins. All-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=64'b1, exactly as in the reference. Every input is unrestricted binary data. Ports, unsigned declarations, parameter names, and parameter defaults are preserved, including LEVELS and W. Other configurations use the reference algorithm, preserving its truncation and default behavior. The design is entirely combinational and requires no helper modules, state, latency, assumptions, or undefined outputs. This module has no CRC ports."
}
